podcast.title: Racist Tirade and Retirement
podcast.body: In late 2006, a video surfaced online of him launching into an "expletive-laced racist tirade" at audience members. Due to the significant media coverage of this event, Richards announced his retirement from stand-up in early 2007. "But in late 2006, a video of him launching into an expletive-laced racist tirade at audience members was posted online."
